page_title: MAR 3-0 BRE | Marseille v Brest 08/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Willy Delajod has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' A player from Brest commits a rough challenge. Willy Delajod blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
90+2' Brest hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
90+2' Fouls committed – 12:9.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Matt O'Riley (Marseille).
88' The game is pretty dull as Marseille are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.
86' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg goes off the pitch and Darryl Bakola (Marseille) comes on.
86' It is time for a substitution. Tadjidine Mmadi (Marseille) is on for Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang.
82' Eric Roy decides to make a substitution. Joris Chotard will be replaced by Junior Dina Ebimbe (Brest).
81' 3 - 0 Goal! Matt O'Riley plays a pass to the feet of Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille), and he shoots into the bottom right corner from inside the box. It's 3:0.
81' The Marseille players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
79' Substitution. Mason Greenwood makes way for Robinio Vaz (Marseille).
79' Substitution. Nayef Aguerd walks off the pitch and CJ Egan-Riley (Marseille) comes on as a substitute.
77' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Brest.
74' Eric Roy has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Hamidou Makalou (Brest) replacing Hugo Magnetti.

74' Nayef Aguerd (Marseille) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
73' Marseille have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

73' A terrific piece of skill by Mason Greenwood (Marseille) inside the box gives him a clear goal scoring opportunity, but his shot is blocked right on the line by a defender after the keeper was beaten.
72' Great teamplay by Marseille as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
70' Substitution. Matt O'Riley (Marseille) on for Angel Gomes.
69' A quickly taken corner by Marseille.

68' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Radoslaw Majecki guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
67' Marseille quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

64' A fine move culminates with a precision cross onto the head of Joris Chotard (Brest) in the centre of the box. It's a good attempt but goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
64' The Brest players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
61' Marseille control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
59' Nice passing game by Brest. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
57' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
54' The ball is out of play. Brest will have a chance to score from a corner.

52' Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to rifle a shot low into the middle of the goal, but Geronimo Rulli makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
50' The Brest players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
47' Emerson (Marseille) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
46' Eric Roy has decided to make a change. Lucas Tousart (Brest) replaces Pathe Mboup.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mama Balde trots off the pitch and is replaced by Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest).
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' Marseille enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
45+2' Daouda Guindo (Brest) nicely brought down the pass, but his long-range effort was wild and went well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
45+1' Marseille seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Marseille.
43' Total attempts – 10:1.
40' The Marseille players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
37' Pathe Mboup (Brest) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.

36' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
33' 2 - 0 Goal! Radoslaw Majecki gets a hand on the penalty from Mason Greenwood (Marseille), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom left corner.
33' We are about to witness a substitution. Daouda Guindo (Brest) is replacing Bradley Locko.
32' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

31' Kenny Lala (Brest) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Willy Delajod with no other option than to blow for a foul. PENALTY to Marseille! Great chance to score.
29' Marseille take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
29' Michael Murillo (Marseille) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
29' Marseille are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
27' Pathe Mboup (Brest) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Geronimo Rulli comes off the line to clear the ball away.
27' The ball is cleared after Mama Balde (Brest) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
25' 1 - 0 What a disaster from Radoslaw Majecki, who fumbles the free kick from Angel Gomes (Marseille) and let’s the ball slip into the net. It’s now 1:0.
24' The referee blows his whistle after Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball. Marseille win a free kick.
21' Ball possession – 69:31.
18' Great teamplay by Brest as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
15' Marseille are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
13' Angel Gomes (Marseille) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
12' Neat passing move from Marseille in order to create new attacking opportunities.

10' Igor Paixao (Marseille) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.

7' What a huge chance for Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.

5' The rebound finds Mason Greenwood (Marseille) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
5' Wonderful movement by Marseille. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
2' The Marseille players are exchanging some short passes.
